note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: We buy about 20,000 reams of copy paper a year from one supplier at $5.40 a ream, and the contract ends next quarter.

answers.common.decision: Which suppliers to invite to quote and on what terms; the procurement manager approves.
answers.common.deadline: Before the contract ends next quarter.
answers.common.materials: Our paper budget for next year is $97,200. Facilities wants recycled paper and delivery to all our offices.
answers.legal-contracts-procurement.documents: The current supply contract and our purchase history.
answers.legal-contracts-procurement.reviewer: The procurement manager approves every request sent to suppliers.
